continuationGovernor.stopReason: Fresh live Hostinger smoke is green and current production remains unchanged, but referral production activation is blocked by a verified schema/runtime mismatch: generic private encryption now emits keyVersion v2 while unapplied referral migration 0029 constrains creator email and payout private payload keys to v1. A bounded append-only compatibility repair is designed and awaits explicit approval before implementation.

rules: Treat feat/mystery-foundation as canonical until final release promotion.
Require fresh CI, Browser QA, exact release health, live-product and database evidence before launch-success claims.
Never expose encryption keys, OTPs, sessions, raw answers, addresses, database credentials, payment secrets or provider secrets.
Do not rotate QUIZ_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V2 or IDENTITY_HMAC_KEY without an explicit continuity plan.
Do not mutate frozen release candidate branches.
Do not change the current Hostinger hPanel branch selection; prior branch changes reset environment variables.
Migration 0033 is approved, applied and live; preserve its schema and hashed-only privacy contract.
Keep Printful production confirmation disabled until the explicit manufacturing launch gate.
Do not create real Safepay charges solely for QA.

Do not apply referral migrations 0029, 0034 or any compatibility follow-up until the referral private-payload v2 repair is verified and the production referral-activation checkpoint is explicitly approved.

Do not send creator launch outreach until referral migrations are live, the intended creator roster is reviewed, provider email configuration is green and the Owner explicitly triggers /ops/referral-launch.
Do not cut issuedonce.shop until all temporary-host provider, customer-flow and email-deliverability gates are green.

referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.runtimeEvidence: src/server/crypto/privatePayload.ts encryptPrivatePayload always returns version 1, keyVersion v2
referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.serviceEvidence: OpsReferralService uses encryptPrivatePayload by default for both creator email and payout details
referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.schemaEvidence: unapplied migration 0029 constrains referral_creators.email_key_version = v1 and referral_payout_requests.details_key_version = v1
referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.typeEvidence: PostgresReferralRepository NotificationInputRow and PostgresOpsReferralRepository PayoutDetailsRow are v1-only
referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.impact: Applying 0029 as-is then creating a real creator or payout with current runtime encryption can fail at the database or violate repository typing expectations.
referralPrivatePayloadCompatibility.proposedRepair: Add append-only migration 0035 to allow v1/v2 referral private-payload key versions; widen stale repository row types to v1|v2; TDD v2 creator/payout round-trip; full CI/browser; temporary-Neon rehearsal before any production application.

launchBlockers: Referral private-payload v2 compatibility repair must be implemented and verified before referral migration activation.
Confirm truthful MERCHANT_PUBLIC_NAME, MERCHANT_SUPPORT_EMAIL and MERCHANT_PUBLIC_LOCATION.
Confirm SUPPORT_INBOX_EMAIL and positive support-delivery proof; current support_requests count is zero.
Confirm Safepay runtime and webhook credentials/environment without creating a QA charge.
Confirm Printful webhook/runtime configuration while production confirmation remains disabled.
Confirm OPENAI_API_KEY and ARTWORK_SIGNING_KEY through safe positive design/artwork proof.
Complete one owner-managed OTP verification and shipping journey that produces verified_contacts.key_version=v2 and shipping_snapshots.key_version=v2.
After repair, run referral database preflight, then obtain explicit production activation approval before applying 0029, 0034 and 0035 in the verified order.
After referral schema activation, create/review the intended creator roster before any launch email is sent.
Only after temporary-host provider/customer/email gates are green, request/execute canonical issuedonce.shop cutover and repeat complete proof.
